Create a .clangd configuration file

Source: R/51_use_clangd.R
use_clangd.Rd

Writes a .clangd configuration file at path with CompileFlags set to include headers from the system R installation and from common C++ interface packages (Rcpp, RcppEigen, RcppArmadillo). If path is the root of an R package (contains a DESCRIPTION file), an additional If: block is appended that disables background indexing for the R/ source directory, since it only contains R code, not C++ source. In that case .clangd is also added to .Rbuildignore (inside a scoped project, so the active project of the calling session is restored afterwards).

  • .clangd is the configuration file read by the clangd language server. It is typically placed in the project root.

  • The system R include directory is obtained via base::R.home() with component "include".

  • Package include directories are obtained via base::system.file() with package = <pkg>.

  • Packages that are not installed (or that have no include/ directory) are skipped with a cli::cli_warn() warning.

Usage

use_clangd(
  path = NULL,
  include = c("Rcpp", "RcppEigen", "RcppArmadillo"),
  overwrite = FALSE,
  open = rlang::is_interactive(),
  ...
)

Arguments

path

Character. Path to the directory where .clangd should be written. If NULL (the default), the current working directory is used.

include

Character vector of package names whose include/ directories should be added to CompileFlags.Add. Defaults to c("Rcpp", "RcppEigen", "RcppArmadillo"). Pass character(0) to add only the system R include path. Custom names such as "BH" are supported; if the package is not installed, its include path is skipped and a warning is emitted.

overwrite

Logical. If TRUE, overwrite an existing .clangd file. Defaults to FALSE.

open

Logical. Whether to open the created file in the editor. Defaults to rlang::is_interactive(). Only takes effect when rstudioapi is installed.

...

Must be empty. Reserved for future arguments.

Value

Invisibly returns the path to the created .clangd file.

Examples

# \donttest{
tmp <- tempdir()
use_clangd(path = tmp)
#> Warning: Package RcppEigen is not installed; skipping its include path.
#> Warning: Package RcppArmadillo is not installed; skipping its include path.
#> ✔ Created /tmp/RtmplPre7l/.clangd.

# Custom include library names
use_clangd(
  path = tmp,
  include = c("Rcpp", "BH"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
#> ! Overwriting /tmp/RtmplPre7l/.clangd.
#> Warning: Package BH is not installed; skipping its include path.
#> ✔ Created /tmp/RtmplPre7l/.clangd.
# }
